textbookBox.concept: Tall, short, long, wide, deep, high and broad are all words used in daily life for different lengths. Height, width, breadth and depth all measure length.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Tall, short, long, wide, deep, high and broad are all words used in daily life for different lengths. Height, width, breadth and depth all measure length.
beats.speakEn: Tall, short, long, wide, deep, high and broad are all words used in daily life for different lengths. Height, width, breadth and depth all measure length.

beats.en: We can make ropes of 1 metre, half a metre and a quarter of a metre. Two half-metre ropes make a one-metre rope, and four quarter-metre ropes make a one-metre rope.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 4 maths · Measuring Length · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: A blue whale is about 30 metres long. A bus is about 10 metres long, and a cricket bat is about 1 metre. So we can compare animals using familiar things.

beats.en: A blue whale is about 30 metres long. A bus is about 10 metres long, and a cricket bat is about 1 metre. So we can compare animals using familiar things. Two blue whales are about 60 metres, which is as long as 6 buses.
beats.speakEn: A blue whale is about 30 metres long. A bus is about 10 metres long, and a cricket bat is about 1 metre. So we can compare animals using familiar things. Two blue whales are about 60 metres, which is as long as 6 buses.

beats.en: A metre is too long to measure small things like an eraser or a grain of rice. We need a smaller unit called the centimetre, written cm. A metre scale is divided into 100 equal parts.
beats.speakEn: A metre is too long to measure small things like an eraser or a grain of rice. We need a smaller unit called the centimetre, written cm. A metre scale is divided into 100 equal parts.
